Plot nested functional trial random-intercept scientific source artists

etr_plot_functional_trial_random_effects.Rd

Frozen Python eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 source-scientific plot geometry, while preserving original native R scientific estimators and default base R return values.

Usage

etr_plot_functional_trial_random_effects(result, participant_id = NULL,
  max_trials = 12L, strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

result

Native realized nested trial random-intercept record with first-seen trial IDs and source time values.

participant_id

Optional exact participant ID filter.

max_trials

Positive integer source trial selection cap; strict mode requires an R integer.

strict_source_record

TRUE returns frozen source scientific line artists, original first-seen trial grouping, source legend and horizontal zero line instead of numeric source audit geometry.

Value

Original invisible nested trial numerical data frame geometry by default. Strict mode returns typed native R source scientific artist coordinates and labels with the selected trial-level BLUP curves, source solid zero line and no averaging; Python runtime Axes object remains outside scope.

Details

Bounded native source-scientific artist parity only: no Python dataclass or pandas runtime protocol, injected Axes identity, pixel rendering equivalence, exception subclass identity, exact-head executable qualification or independent full-source contract certification.
